Process

How the work unfolded

Chapter 1

Discovery

Stakeholder interviewsUser interviewsPersonasUser journey

The opportunity was rooted in search behavior: millions of people were already looking for career information, but the experience around that intent was disconnected and uneven.

Chapter 2

Workshop

North starRoadmap

Cross-functional workshops helped align business goals and user needs around a realistic multi-year north star rather than a collection of disconnected content improvements.

Chapter 3

Design

FlowsWireframes

I focused on how information should be sequenced and how users move between role overviews, requirements, salary signals, and adjacent opportunities.

Chapter 4

Evaluative research

User testing

Testing confirmed strong interest in using the product in the future, while also revealing a desire for more detailed guidance on how to start and progress in a given career.

Chapter 5

Milestones & iterations

Landing pageFilters & sortingCompany pagesA/B tests

Subsequent iterations improved search, filtering, and relevance, steadily raising performance and helping the experience scale to more markets and more content types.
